bio: Awarded ‘Best Afternoon Tea 2022’ by Condé Nast Johansens Awards for Excellence, there’s nowhere quite like The Grand when it comes to dining in York. Presented on a silver stand, their elaborate tower of savoury and sweet treats is a feast for the eyes as well as the taste buds.  Take in stunning views of the city walls from The Rise as you indulge in the best contemporary take on Afternoon Tea in York, with optional Prosecco, Champagne, and Gin & Tonic upgrades, perfect for special occasions.  Please note that a discretionary service charge of 12.5% will be added to your bill.
